findings.title: The file collector trusts an external share-set label over the embedded identifier
evidence: crates/mnemocode-embroidery/src/found.rs:269
docs/audits/AUD-009-harnesses/src/collector.rs:25
Local evidence: AUD-009-evidence/new-regressions-corrected.log
findings.reproduction: Create two independently valid 2-of-3 public SSKR sets. Take member 1 from A and member 2 from B, label both card pages as set A, then collect the pages.
findings.expected: Treat conflicting embedded set identifiers as a damaged/mixed set; do not advertise it as a usable quorum.
findings.observed: The collector checks group topology and sizes but not info.identifier. It returns trouble=None for a set that restore_complete rejects with ConflictKind::Set. Fresh bounded regression reproduced this result after its positive controls passed.
findings.impact: Folder discovery promises recovery that the recovery engine correctly refuses. This does not show reconstruction of an incorrect phrase or bypass of SSKR validation.
findings.recommendedFix: Validate embedded set identifiers and their correspondence to the external card label before merging.
findings.requiredVerification: Exercise genuine multi-group sets as a positive control, mismatched IDs as a negative control, and mixed metadata across all discovery sources.

findings.title: A malformed surplus card share is silently discarded
evidence: crates/mnemocode-embroidery/src/found.rs:439
docs/audits/AUD-009-harnesses/src/collector.rs:67
Local evidence: AUD-009-evidence/new-regressions-corrected.log
findings.reproduction: Supply two valid shares of a 2-of-3 set and a third card page with a contiguous but truncated list containing only its first code.
findings.expected: Restore using the valid quorum and report the damaged extra file.
findings.observed: read_share errors are discarded by if let Ok; a contiguous short card list avoids the earlier missing-position error and does not produce a warning. Fresh bounded regression reproduced this result after its positive controls passed.
findings.impact: The recoverable set remains usable, but a damaged backup silently appears unproblematic. The original complete-quorum failure was fixed; this is a distinct reporting omission.
findings.recommendedFix: Convert share-parsing errors into damaged-file notes while keeping the available quorum usable.
findings.requiredVerification: Test both a gap in card numbering and a contiguous invalid/truncated payload, with and without a complete valid quorum.

findings.title: Repeated card exports with different decoys collide in discovery
evidence: crates/mnemocode-cards/src/templates.rs:457
crates/mnemocode-cards/src/printed.rs:282
docs/audits/AUD-009-harnesses/src/cards.rs:14
Local evidence: AUD-009-evidence/new-regressions-corrected.log
findings.reproduction: Export the same public 12-word Colors backup twice using business-it with independent synthetic decoy pools. Serialize the retained page metadata through xmp/pages_in and collect both exports.
findings.expected: Both independently readable copies remain discoverable; differing decoys do not invalidate the real backup.
findings.observed: The document ID depends on the real codes while the retained text also contains random decoys. Equal IDs with different decoy text become a Different conflict. Fresh bounded regression reproduced this result after its positive controls passed.
findings.impact: A directory containing repeated valid exports can report an unreadable backup although either export alone works. This is a discovery failure, not demonstrated data corruption.
findings.recommendedFix: Give complete export instances suitable identities or explicitly distinguish invariant payload from variable decoration without suppressing real conflicts.
findings.requiredVerification: Check same-plan sheet/card merging, repeated exports with different decoys, exact copies, and genuine contradictory real codes.

findings.title: Returning to a completed Saving step resets the output checkboxes
evidence: crates/mnemocode-cli/src/commands/new_backup.rs:283
crates/mnemocode-cli/src/commands/encode_questions.rs:496
crates/mnemocode-cli/src/terminal/choice.rs:657
findings.reproduction: Change the Output checklist, finish the Saving questions, then navigate back from a later stage to Saving without changing the backup mode or form.
findings.expected: Retain the selected destinations when revisiting this completed step.
findings.observed: saved_where invokes ask_destination again, which initializes ticked from ticked_first. choose_many does not use the single-choice memory. Returning within the nested Saving questions does retain the ticks. Static trace; no dedicated PTY replay yet.
findings.impact: Backtracking can replace explicitly chosen output destinations with defaults; the person can reselect them. The original child single-choice memory fix is independent.
findings.recommendedFix: Preserve the destination selection across calls, resetting only when incompatible form/mode changes require it.
findings.requiredVerification: PTY test that changes destinations, completes Saving, returns from the next stage, and verifies both ticks and generated destinations.
